To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: NovaAI pilot surge credits and milestone alignment

Hi Aditya,

Quick note — our NovaAI team has seen a sudden usage spike from a partner integration (unexpected batch evaluation) and we will run out of our pilot credits in ~48 hours unless we get a top-up. The current pilot was scoped for evaluation only; the spike is due to a customer demo scheduled for Dec 7 that we cannot postpone.

Ask: would Redwood be able to approve a one-off 50k token credit top-up and a 30-day extension to our pilot window so we can finish the integration and present the demo? We can commit to a short milestone checklist:
- Dec 3: end-to-end demo stable
- Dec 7: customer presentation
- Dec 15: decision point (pilot -> paid)

I attached a small usage export so you can see the surge pattern (novaai_usage_q4.csv). We appreciate any short-term flexibility here — this presentation materially affects our purchasing decision.

Thanks,
Elliot Chan
